title: Standings split one club into two rows (Athletico vs Atletico Paranaense)
evidence: Sources/BrazilianSoccerMCP/SoccerStore.swift:40-46 normalized() folds diacritics and strips state suffixes but does not reconcile the 'Athletico'/'Atletico' (h) spelling, and standings() keys by normalized(name) at :86; _factual.json 2019 Serie A output has 21 rows: 'Athletico Paranaense' (pos 12, 27 matches, 48 pts) + 'Atletico Paranaense' (pos 21, 11 matches, 16 pts) are the same club = 38 matches. factual_accuracy=0.5.
suggestion: Add an alias mapping both spellings (athletico/atletico paranaense -> one key), or normalize the 'h' before keying, so the club aggregates into a single 20th row.

title: Statistical analysis is thin: win_rate + home-only record only
evidence: Models.swift:48 computes win_rate; SoccerStore.swift:64-71 teamRecord supports homeOnly; main.swift:38 data_summary aggregates counts. No dedicated avg-goals/match, biggest-wins, or explicit home-vs-away comparison tool. Meets how_to_verify ('at least one aggregate statistic') via win_rate.
suggestion: Add a stats tool computing avg goals/match and biggest wins for richer coverage of R10's examples.
